hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook integrating with Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote using a custom bonding curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — bypassing Uniswap's internal CLAMM pricing. Standard liquidity positions and donations are intentionally blocked.
